Subjects were profiled from public search snippets so a classifier can tell them from namesakes: Nidhi Hooda is the founder of Growpido LLC. The snippets describe her as a reputation architect and strategic influence or narrative advisor. Growpido is a Dubai, U.A.E. based reputation advisory and executive branding company. Mentions came from web and news searches; LinkedIn results were kept as search engine snippets and never fetched, nothing behind a login was read. Every mention was classified by gpt-5.4-mini; anything not a confident ignore was classified again by gpt-5.6-terra.
